promotion.rule: Cut a new immutable snapshot deliberately from validated Data Lab state; only then may development move to that new pin. Never build development directly from Data Lab main.

development.rule: Pinned nine-country baseline plus official 3795-PDC EnergyVision Belgium CPO source. Development-only candidate allows 1940 active strict VAT-included exact Direct offers: prior 778 simple + 1162 exact conditional 45-minute post-charge, 360-minute daytime post-charge and 1080-minute connected-duration tariffs. User-confirmed semantic examples, strict DATEX source-shape guards, and independent oracles; no extrapolation to differently structured price groups, no automatic publication. Unknown/inoperative stations and any incomplete or ambiguous rules fail closed. Spain REVE uses a separately pinned Data Lab last-good bundle; Ze-Watt and Zephyre direct offers and the byte-identical validated Italy runtime are pinned Data Lab inputs. The V9 shell FX file uses a separately pinned Data Lab last-good rate file. France IRVE static tiles use a separately pinned byte-identical Data Lab copy of the last validated generation while the newer national connector scope remains under investigation. The historical V9 data and control files are loaded from a digest-pinned Data Lab archive; active V9 runtime code remains Production-owned. The public site still requires an explicit Pages dispatch.
